EduPlan Studio
Go 1.22+ / React 18 PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector Temporal / Asynq v2.4 (Enterprise)
1. Executive Summary & Core Platform Vision
EduPlan Studio is an enterprise edtech backend and administrative control platform designed to unify
curriculum resource discovery, AI-assisted lesson plan generation, strict approval workflows, and immutable
version control. Built on a high-throughput Golang core with a responsive React frontend, it empowers
educators and administrators to maintain academic standards with zero computational overhead.
Key Architectural Pillar: Decoupled, modular Go microservices utilizing SQLC for high-performance type-safe queries,
Casbin for dynamic role-based permissions, and LangChainGo with pgvector for semantic curriculum retrieval.

4. Database Schema Specification (SQLC Compatible)
The system utilizes PostgreSQL 16 with the pgvector extension. Below is the production table definition for
structured lesson plans and semantic curriculum embeddings.
-- Enable pgvector extension for RAG Search
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
-- Core Lesson Plans Table
CREATE TABLE lesson_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    subject VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    grade_level VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', -- DRAFT, REVIEW, APPROVED, PUBLISHED
    current_version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1.0',
    content_json JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
-- Version History Log Table (Immutable Delta Storage)
CREATE TABLE lesson_plan_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    lesson_plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version_tag VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    snapshot_json JSONB NOT NULL,
    change_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
-- Curriculum Standard Embeddings for Semantic RAG
CREATE TABLE curriculum_resources (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    subject VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    embedding vector(1536) -- OpenAI / Nomic Vector Size
);
CREATE INDEX idx_curriculum_vector ON curriculum_resources 
USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);
5. AI Generation & Semantic RAG Search Pipeline
The lesson plan generator uses a hybrid RAG approach: standard curriculum frameworks are contextually
retrieved via vector similarity and passed into an LLM prompt to output strict JSON.
1. Context Retrieval (RAG)
Queries PostgreSQL using cosine distance on user prompt
vectors to find matching educational benchmarks.
SELECT code, description 
FROM curriculum_resources
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 
LIMIT 3;
2. Structured Extraction
Enforces JSON Schema constraint via LangChainGo to
populate lesson sections reliably.
type LessonOutput struct {
    Objectives []string `json:"obj"`
    Activities []Activity`json:"act"`
}

7. Security & Granular Access Control (Casbin Model)
EduPlan Studio uses Attribute and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC/ABAC) driven by Casbin. This prevents
unauthorized access across schools, departments, and user roles.
Casbin RBAC Policy (rbac_model.conf)
[request_definition]
r = sub, obj, act
[policy_definition]
p = sub, obj, act
[role_definition]
g = _, _
[policy_effect]
e = some(where (p.eft == allow))
[matchers]
m = g(r.sub, p.sub) && r.obj == p.obj && 
r.act == p.act
Sample Policy Definitions
# Admin Rules
p, admin, lesson_plans, create
p, admin, lesson_plans, publish
p, admin, users, manage
# Teacher Rules
p, teacher, lesson_plans, create
p, teacher, lesson_plans, read
# Role Assignments
g, s.jenkins@academy.edu, admin
g, m.vance@academy.edu, teacher
8. Go Microservices Project Repository Layout
The standard Go monorepo structure segregates domain entities, application services, infrastructure, and web
assets.
eduplan-studio/
├── cmd/
│   ├── api-server/         # Main REST / GraphQL API server entrypoint
│   ├── worker/             # Asynq / Temporal background queue process
│   └── seed/               # Curriculum database seeder
├── internal/
│   ├── domain/             # Entities: LessonPlan, User, Curriculum, Version
│   ├── auth/               # Casbin policies, JWT validation, middleware
│   ├── curriculum/         # RAG pipeline, pgvector similarity search
│   ├── generator/          # LangChainGo integration & structured prompts
│   ├── workflow/           # Temporal workflows, signals, and activities
│   └── storage/            # SQLC generated code & PostgreSQL adapters
├── db/
│   ├── migrations/         # Goose / golang-migrate SQL scripts
│   └── queries/            # SQLC query source files (*.sql)
├── pkg/
│   └── pdf/                # Maroto v2 layout templates & document exporter
└── web/                    # React single page frontend application
9. Production Deployment & SLA Strategy
Containerized Infrastructure
Multi-stage Docker builds yielding <20MB static Go
binaries.
Automated horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA) on
Kubernetes.
Redis cluster backed background queue isolation via
Asynq.
Reliability & SLA Targets
99.9% Uptime: Zero-downtime rolling deployments.
Sub-100ms API Latency: Pre-compiled SQLC queries.
RAG Response: <1.2s embedding & extraction loop.
